evidence.metadata_source: pkg/core/region.go RegionInfo.GetID/GetStartKey/GetEndKey/GetPeers/GetRegionEpoch return meta fields. TestNeedSync constructs Id=1000, a..z, ConfVer=100, Version=100 and peers. region_option.go SetRegionConfVer/SetRegionVersion accept uint64 and distinguish nil epoch. u64::MAX preservation and zero defaults follow unsigned field types, without arithmetic; absent epoch is represented as None. Owned cloning is the Rust value contract; no Go clone differential is claimed.
